Formulify brings Formula 1 Widgets to Your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

For beginning, app brings F1 Calendar with all session times and even more, a countdown to upcoming Race Start. Next it gives You the opportunity to track the current Standings - both Constructors Championship and Drivers championship. And all this with different Widgets variations. Apart from this, You can track Your favourite teams with 'WCC Grid Widget', which can be customised to show Constructor standings of Your preferred teams. Similarly, possibility to track progress of Your favourite drivers with Custom 'F1 Driver Standings' Widget is available. One more thing - rewind of most legendary F1 radio messages is present with 'Team Radio Message of the Day' Widget, which as its title hints, refreshes daily with radio message of the day.

Widgets are available as both Home-Screen & Lock-Screen and are updated on regular basis with aim to bring latest result as soon as possible for entire 2023 F1 season.
